metadata.title: Self measurable embeddings of mapping class groups
metadata.abstract: Given a finite-type orientable surface without boundary, outside of a few low-complexity surfaces, we show that any measurable embedding of the associated mapping class group into itself is a measure equivalence. This is a measure-theoretic analog to the result of Ivanov and McCarthy that mapping class groups are co-Hopfian.
metadata.comment: 49 pages, 4 figures. This text is written in Atkinson hyperlegible font. This can be changed to Computer Modern or OpenSans by downloading the sources and commenting/uncommenting the lines as explained in the source tex file

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: 证明除少数低复杂度例外外，有限型无边界可定向曲面的映射类群任意自可测嵌入都是测度等价，形成 co-Hopf 性的测度版本。

analysis.breakthrough: 证明除少数低复杂度例外外，有限型无边界可定向曲面的映射类群任意自可测嵌入都是测度等价，形成 co-Hopf 性的测度版本。
analysis.limitations: 结论排除低复杂度曲面。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者披露曾出于好奇向 LLM 询问一次证明和三次文献，但明确称回复均无结论且没有用于本文；不能算作研究协作成果。
